name: pr-validation
description: Pull request validation for purity, idempotency, BDD scenario coverage, and protection claims backed by tests

interface.shortDescription: Validate PR behavior, coverage, and protection claims
interface.longDescription: Audit pull requests for functional purity, idempotent state transitions, BDD scenario coverage, and protection claims backed by tests that fail when the protection is removed.
defaultPrompt: Validate this pull request with the PR validation workflow.
